KR.warmup: retain full original state lookback before evaluation

proposedHistoricalWindows.status: NEW_EXPLORATORY_SCOPE_PROPOSAL_ONLY; each source/window requires fresh admission and owner approval. No original execution wrapper, lock or consumed permit is reused.

arms.S2: S0 except FAST=1 AND close>max(previous 20 exchange-session closes) target=1
arms.S3: S1 plus S2; FAST=2 always vetoes early re-entry

preOutcomeClarifications: The breakout compares t against t-20..t-1, never includes t in the high. Require all 21 calendar-aligned valid closes, not just 21 rows.
All arms use the same weekly C1 decision grid and next exchange-session close. No daily early-reentry arm, latch, grid search or extra hysteresis.
The override is memoryless. If the next weekly signal no longer meets the trigger, the original C1 map applies; resulting whipsaw is a cost, not fixed after outcomes.
Missing input is completed over its domain. If all completions agree use that answer, otherwise hold that arm's previous target; an undefined first target blocks.
Known-at is checked at the decision cutoff. The unchanged layer adapter retains four-calendar-day FRED lag and 14-day staleness; its date-resolution/vintage limitations remain.
KR cutoff is 18:00 KST; US is exchange close+60min, including early closes. No same-close trade.
These clarify the post-C1 proposal before ANY new historical value/return execution; they do not revise a sealed B/C contract.

B.multiplicity: existing Holm .05 family of two; not pooled with C1c
B.B-H1: rp1-b-h1-state-v1 is state-only prospective. FAST=2 OR trailing calendar-24-month return<0 unchanged. H63 outcome contract not registered; D1-D8 remain open.
B.B-H2: p=1 until an eligible development-supported Study A signal exists; outcome contract/own inference gates also required
B.estimand: unscaled same-stock/same-industry signal excess return by signal-time state, and incremental prediction error; never overlay-scaled returns
B.dataPolicy: retain Study ID, original spec hash, signal key, evidence class, horizon, cohort and validity mask; never pool prospective and exposed historical evidence

C1c.metric: paired annualized mean log-growth for the three contrasts; CAGR/MDD are separate economic axes, not an additive profit decomposition
C1c.averageFactorEffects: reported descriptively, never additional selection opportunities
C1c.classification: fixed FAST/SLOW/TRANSITION severity only; no classifier training or new risk threshold
C1c.validity: one common complete calendar/path mask for all four cells and controls. Missing required price/cash/action basis blocks the entire market/basis reading; no surviving-arm selection.
C1c.inference: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY. No p-values, SUPPORTED label or alpha claim without separate pre-outcome calibration/independent review. No pooling B/C p-values or markets.

US_PRIMARY.accounting: C1_PRIMARY_REPLICA; original uncharged initialization; noninvestable diagnostic

US_ECONOMIC.asset: separately admitted SPY cash-dividend total return
US_ECONOMIC.cash: DTB3 known at previous close, actual calendar days/360
US_ECONOMIC.accounting: ETF_CASH_ECONOMIC; funded entry and final liquidation for every arm/control; source rights and external total-return reconciliation must pass separately

KR_PRIMARY.accounting: C1_PRIMARY_REPLICA; comparability only; never claim ETF economics or rerun the old KR study

KR_ECONOMIC.cash: zero; BOK sensitivity requires its own approved specification
KR_ECONOMIC.accounting: ETF_CASH_ECONOMIC; same funded entry/liquidation; existing commission 1.5bps + half of 8bps spread; no stock tax on domestic equity ETF

timingAttribution: report net arithmetic identity = cash + mean-exposure premium + weight/return covariance - cost impact, including residual; mean exposure is ex post and NOT a tradable control or proof of timing skill. Static 40/70 controls expose simple lower beta; CAGR alone never establishes selection/timing alpha.
metrics: H63 false alarms and pending counts
metricConventions: ETF economic CAGR starts from initial wealth 1, includes funded entry/final liquidation and annualizes by 252/(number of close intervals). A target scheduled exactly at final liquidation is not rebalanced before liquidation. Entry cost is an initial fee observation in daily-return diagnostics. Monthly/first-year/first-half results include initial fee. Switching turnover and full entry/exit lifecycle turnover are separate. Up/down classification uses the underlying asset return, not passive trading fees. Primary replication retains original initialization.

successStopProposal.meaningfulImprovement: net CAGR >= S0 plus 0.005 OR |MDD| <= 0.90*|MDD_S0|; inherited C tolerances, never retuned
successStopProposal.timingClaim: requires evidence beyond simple/static exposure, costs and cash yield. Positive covariance or one better CAGR does not suffice.
successStopProposal.costRobustness: publish all x1/x2/x3 results; losing signs, shallow protection and whipsaw remain visible; do not nominate the best cost assumption
successStopProposal.stop: any unverified source/basis/calendar/rights aborts before historical reads; no complete four-cell comparison means UNRESOLVED. No economically eligible arm means NO_EDGE. Several Pareto tradeoffs remain ambiguous, never forced winner.
successStopProposal.promotion: none, even after favorable exploration; requires independently registered prospective validation and owner risk-budget decision

futureHypotheses.continuousVolTarget: one separate capped inverse-volatility hypothesis; window/target/cap/zero-vol/missing rules UNREGISTERED, no implementation or result here
futureHypotheses.cashVsShortBill: one separate investable cash/short-bill hypothesis; rate proxy is not bond total return, and duration/credit/spread/rights must be specified; UNREGISTERED

executionGate: independent design/PIT/cost/family audit on exact HEAD
owner accepts exact numeric protocol and each admitted market/basis/source window
source rights, identity, full calendar and corporate-action/return-basis proofs
new append-only run manifest with code/protocol/input/runtime hashes and distinct attempt namespace
explicit owner approval for that exact new manifest; original KR/C1 locks/results never reused
marketInterface: bounded market risk multiplier 0..1, signal/execution/knownAt/study/source hashes, appliedScope=MARKET_RISK_ONCE; apply once to a fixed future eligible book. B state context never supplies another risk multiplier. Industry/Stock development proceeds independently even if market timing fails. No production integration.
